reviews.text:
Good, very professional work.

Except!!!!! It's impossible to get an appointment; it's all based on who you are, or rather, who you think they're best! They only take what they want! Or they favor their own clients! I just realized this: an acquaintance got an appointment after I went, even though I was told there were no openings! When the employee looks at the schedule, you see the available slots—blank spaces. This isn't the first time this has happened to me. They tell you they'll call you back if there are any cancellations! When you're in business, you have to be honest. Don't treat people like idiots.

For your information, our little dog is absolutely not aggressive.

You'll never see them again.
I had my poodle groomed and she looked beautiful. It took them 2 hr

Fantastic experience with our Maine Coon cat! The groomer was so kind! I highly recommend her! Our cat had matted fur, and the groomer shaved it off so cleanly! You can barely see the bald patches. Thank you so much!
Thank you so much !

My Teddy looks absolutely stunning when I leave!
Service 5/5!

A huge thank you for the wonderful work you did on my dog, whose long fur was dry and very matted. Thank you for your patience; thanks to you, she'll feel so much better now, and her skin will be able to breathe again! I highly recommend this wonderful groomer who, in addition to being a perfectionist, is incredibly gentle with our animals 🙏
Super friendly owner, very meticulous work, the dogs love him!
First grooming session for my cat, whom we had recently welcomed into the family. The groomer was very gentle and respectful with her. The session went very well. Thank you, we will be back!

My cat has been groomed by Lydia since I arrived in Lyon, and his fur has never looked so good! Lydia takes excellent care of my cat and takes all the time he needs to groom him properly.
I highly recommend the Un Chien Un Chat grooming salon! Thank you, Lydia! 🤩🙏🏼

My kitten's first grooming experience at a salon. He arrived with a very large knot, but she managed to reassure him, and he surprisingly cooperated!
Very gentle and patient, I highly recommend her ✨
A wonderful experience for my 5-month-old puppy who discovered grooming for the first time. Thank you for the gentle approach, professionalism, and their great kindness <3
A wonderful experience! The young woman was very kind, affectionate with animals, and passionate about her work. I highly recommend her!
The best grooming in Lyon and the surrounding area, attentive, patient, and highly skilled. Thank you!

Fantastic experience!
Milo came out with a truly superb haircut 😍
The groomer took great care with his coat, being very careful to preserve it, which was very important to me.
The result is both natural and very handsome; Milo looks magnificent.
I highly recommend them!
Hello Manon, thank you for your rating, we look forward to welcoming you again!

I regularly take my dog ​​to this groomer; she's absolutely lovely and very gentle with dogs. My dog, who's usually terrified of everything, is never afraid of going to the groomer thanks to her. My Spitz's fur and skin are treated with the utmost care, and afterward she smells wonderful, and you can really see a difference in the quality of her coat.
I highly recommend her.
A huge thank you for the amazing top-style grooming of our Yorkie Biewer… our baby looks magnificent, well done and thank you! See you very, very soon… Nil

Gaya left looking beautiful, relaxed, and peaceful—and I was overjoyed to know she was in such good hands.

I wholeheartedly recommend you without hesitation!
Thank you Isabelle! Looking forward to seeing you again!

I'm absolutely delighted with the way Lydia takes care of Odin. You can tell how much the animals are loved by the way they're pampered. I'm already looking forward to the next time. And you, don't hesitate!

The grooming for my wire-haired dachshund was absolutely perfect! Truly amazing!

I've rarely seen such excellent grooming. The welcome and their understanding of my dog's habits were exceptional.

After many comings and goings of dog groomers in the sixth arrondissement, we finally have one who truly loves our animals and gives adorable cuts. Best of all, my dog  Igor adores her. All this, plus creative and charming window displays and a bright new interior !

I highly recommend this grooming salon!
Lydia is exceptional with animals 🥰🥰 She's so kind and, above all, very professional 👍👍
Thank you for the gentle care you give our little babies 🥰🥰🥰
The salon is beautiful, perfectly clean, and especially very relaxing for the animals.
BRAVO and thank you again! 👏👏👏👏👏

A warm welcome and, above all, exceptional gentleness... she managed to trim my cat's claws (which were much too long) in three minutes flat. I highly recommend her and I will definitely be back.
